comments.body:
they're not too bad but you absolutely cannot get caught melee'ing them or they'll swarm and you'll never be able to get out. run to the edge and don't let them get too close, be looking for the couple that seem to want to stay out by themselves and concentrate on them until you get 4 or 5 of them sunk. Galleass' really seem to like getting critted cause they run straight at you. Cannons instead of carronades and wait for the bow shot.

Alternateively, the admiral spawns away from the main fleet, find him and quickly take him out before the rest get there and quest is over, just not as much xp/fame.
